question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word in the brackets to fill in the blank.

The pool was too ______ at this end for kids to play. [SHALLOW]
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"shallow"** means not deep; having little depth. (उथला)
 
 
• **Example: **The water in the river is too shallow for boats to pass.
 
 
 
• **"Deep"** refers to something that has a large distance from the top or surface to the bottom. (गहरा)
 
 
• **Example: **The well is very deep, so be careful not to fall in.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'shallow' **is **'deep'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Green** (हरा): A color between blue and yellow in the spectrum.
 
 
• **Example:** The leaves on the tree are lush and green.
 
 
 
• **Blue** (नीला): A color resembling that of the clear sky.
 
 
• **Example:** The sky is clear and blue today.
 
 
 
• **Cold** (ठंडा): Of or at a low temperature, especially when compared to the temperature of the human body.
 
 
• **Example:** The water in the pool is too cold for swimming.
